save_image_manifold: save an image array to a target file path using imageio.imwrite
g_pathmgr_mkdirs: create directories recursively using g_pathmgr.mkdirs with exist_ok behavior
g_pathmgr_isfile: check if a path is a file using g_pathmgr.isfile
g_pathmgr_exists: check if a path exists using g_pathmgr.exists which wraps os.path.exists
change_to_sr: pass through a list of file paths unchanged using change_to_sr
